batch.topic: A team says a proposal is a long shot and wants to try it anyway; idiom means unlikely to succeed, not a long physical shot.
A person is on the fence about taking a role and asks for more information; hesitation is not rejection or physical location.
A new colleague learns the ropes while a mentor retains responsibility for final approval; idiom concerns learning work procedures.
A speaker takes a remark with a grain of salt and checks it against a document; scepticism is not a food instruction.
